# Home Depot (2 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /product | `item_id` / `url` | 5 | Get a Home Depot product by item id or URL |
| /reviews | `item_id` | 5 | Get Home Depot product reviews |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /product — 5cr

Returns full product detail for a Home Depot item: title, brand, model number, UPC, description, highlight bullets, current and original price, star rating with its 1-5 histogram, review count, the image gallery, a grouped specification table, and stock status. It also returns per-store inventory under product.ext.store_inventory, giving the actual unit count on the shelf at each nearby store, which is the field nothing else in this API sells. Pass store_id or zipcode to localise pricing and that inventory. For the review text call GET /v1/home_depot/reviews with the same item id.

**Parameters**

- `store_id` *(optional)*: Home Depot store number used to localise price, stock, and pickup availability, for example 121.
- `zipcode` *(optional)*: Five-digit US ZIP code used to localise delivery options and pricing, for example 30301.
- `item_id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `item_id`: Home Depot internet number (item id), the numeric id at the end of a homedepot.com product URL: homedepot.com/p/<name>/326680222 is item id 326680222. Pass url instead if you would rather hand over the whole product URL. (one of: item_id, url — at least one required)
  - `url`: Full Home Depot product page URL, used instead of item_id. The item id is extracted from it. (one of: item_id, url — at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/home_depot/product?item_id=<item_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /reviews — 5cr

Returns written customer reviews for a Home Depot product, 20 per page and up to 100, each with the review text, star rating, reviewer name, submission date, verified-purchaser flag, helpful-vote count, reviewer photos, and any manufacturer reply. This is the fastest and most complete review surface in the API: pages do not overlap, the review total is stable across pages, and every one of the nine review fields is populated, so a full crawl is deterministic. Pass the returned cursor back until has_more is false.

**Parameters**

- `item_id`: Home Depot internet number (item id), the numeric id at the end of a homedepot.com product URL: homedepot.com/p/<name>/326680222 is item id 326680222. Pass url instead if you would rather hand over the whole product URL.
- `page` *(optional)*: Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter. Native upstream cursor param. Send the universal `cursor` instead — the API maps it to this name for you.
- `items_per_page` *(optional)*: Reviews per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.
- `rating` *(optional)*: Return only reviews with this star rating, 1 to 5.
- `sort_by` *(optional)*: Review ordering: helpful (default), newest, oldest, photos_first, highest_rating, lowest_rating, or relevance.
- `search_text` *(optional)*: Return only reviews whose text contains these words, for example easy to use.
- `verified_only` *(optional)*: Set true to return only reviews written by verified purchasers.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Universal pagination cursor. Send `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous response back verbatim — the API maps it to this endpoint's native `page` (page style). You never construct, decode, or look up a cursor. Omit it for page 1.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/home_depot/reviews?item_id=<item_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```


## Choosing a Home Depot endpoint

| Your goal | Use this | Credits |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| One product's detail (by item id or URL) | `/product` | 5 |
| What buyers say | `/reviews` | 5 |

Two endpoints, both 5 credits, no keyword search. You need an item id or a product URL to
start — if you only have a product name, resolve the URL first with `web/search` (2cr) or
`google_shopping/product-search` (5cr), then come here.

Useful for home-improvement and trade niches where review text carries the real buying
objections. For reviews across several marketplaces at once, `prism/product-reviews` (30cr)
is the one-call version.
